Recommendation: Target and screen the saturated zone between approximately 35–37 m depth, casing off the overlying sandy sequence; because this productive zone is thin and shallow for VES resolution, confirm its true thickness and lithology from drill cuttings and geophysical logging while drilling, and be prepared to deepen into the underlying resistive (likely coarser/sandstone) layer below ~37 m if yield from the primary zone proves inadequate.
